notes: Recorded 32 master's and 22 doctoral programmes: the full list on the university's Programs A-Z page at the Master's and Doctoral Programs levels (the page shows 32 master's and 22 doctoral entries when filtered). The first pass had listed 25 master's programmes; the seven added are Robotics, Biomedical Engineering, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Chemical and Materials Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, and Engineering Management.
Doctor of Medicine is listed by the university under its Master's level; the pages read do not say whether the scholarship applies to it.
The Programs A-Z page also lists undergraduate, residency and preparatory programmes; they are not recorded because this scholarship record covers master's and doctoral levels.
not_stated: A statement that the scholarship is open to every field (the pages read neither restrict nor open it)
Whether the Doctor of Medicine, the Executive MBA or the residency programmes are covered
